name: AiContify
author: Webtinus

sections.description:
AiContify is a lightweight, secure, and intelligent WordPress plugin designed to generate complete content using artificial intelligence — without any license key or payment.

The plugin is fully compliant with WordPress.org rules and focuses on generating high-quality, SEO-optimized content directly inside the WordPress editor.

🆓 Free Version

The free version of AiContify is activated in the Posts section of WordPress and includes the following features:

  • Generate full article content by simply entering a keyword
  • Create content up to 4000 words in length
  • Automatically generate FAQ (Frequently Asked Questions) related to the article
  • Generate SEO Title and Meta Description compatible with SEO plugins like Yoast SEO
  • Support for 13 languages including Persian, English, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Japanese, Russian, Arabic, Hindi, Portuguese, Italian, and Korean
  • Option to choose between the default server prompt or a custom user-defined prompt
  • Fully compatible with both pre-built and custom WordPress themes
  • Works instantly without any complex configuration

🚀 Pro Version

The AiContify Pro edition includes all features from the free version, plus enhanced capabilities for professional users and content creators.

Pro features include:
– Generate content for WooCommerce products (short and long descriptions)
– Full support for Pages in addition to Posts
– Faster processing and higher accuracy using advanced AI models
– Separate custom prompt configuration for each section:
– Main article content
– FAQ section
– SEO title
– Meta description
– WooCommerce product description
– Easy activation through a premium license

The Pro version is designed for professional users who need faster, more precise, and deeply customizable AI-generated content for websites and online stores.

General Features

  • One-click content generation directly inside Gutenberg
  • SEO-friendly and natural language output
  • Secure, sanitized, and properly enqueued assets
  • No external dependencies or license validation required

Note: The free version focuses on generating article content.
Advanced features like WooCommerce or SEO automation are available in the Pro version.

External services

This plugin connects to the AiContify API at:

https://webtinus.com/

Data sent: Post title and optional prompt (user-provided keyword).
Data received: AI-generated article content.
Purpose: To generate original content using the AiContify AI model.
Terms of Service: https://aicontify.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://aicontify.com/privacy/

No user data, IP, or site URL is transmitted. Only the title or keyword is sent.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the aicontify folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin via the WordPress “Plugins” menu
  3. Open any post in the Gutenberg editor
  4. Click the “Generate with AiContify” button in the toolbar
  5. Enter a keyword and click Generate
  6. Insert the AI-generated content with a single click
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key or license?

No. The free AiContify model works immediately after activation — no setup required.

Is this plugin 100% free?

Yes. The free version is fully functional and contains no locked features.

Can I generate FAQs or SEO titles?

Yes. The free version supports FAQ and SEO title generation for articles.

What’s included in the Pro version?

The Pro version adds WooCommerce product content, page support, faster generation, and advanced prompt customization.

Is my data secure?

Yes. Only the keyword/title is transmitted. No personal data, emails, or URLs are collected.
